note: Textbook on starting point: 55, trains four to five days a week, eats cleanly, and wants refinement rather than rescue — 'I don't need to be the strongest guy out there, just fit.' But he is a salaried nurse on an 8:30-to-5 schedule, not a business owner, physician or equivalent, and he answered 'No, I'm a nurse' to the business question. On income he could not fund the programme from cashflow at all: the purchase depends on the proceeds of a house sale one to two months out, and he took a $1,200 entry point rather than the $6,000. 'Neglected health' is the weakest fit of all — his health is the most actively managed part of his life, which is the opposite of the stated profile.
